# buddy_target (Resource)

Create and manage a target

Token scopes required: `TARGET_READ`, `TARGET_WRITE`, `TARGET_MANAGE`

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "buddy_target" "ftp" {
  domain     = "myworkspace"
  name       = "FTP Server"
  identifier = "ftp-server"
  type       = "FTP"
  host       = "ftp.example.com"
  port       = "21"
  secure     = false
  auth {
    username = "ftpuser"
    password = "secret"
  }
}

resource "buddy_target" "ftps_in_project" {
  domain       = "myworkspace"
  project_name = "myproject"
  name         = "FTPS Server"
  identifier   = "ftps-server"
  type         = "FTP"
  host         = "ftp.example.com"
  port         = "21"
  secure       = true
  auth {
    username = "ftpuser"
    password = "secret"
  }
}

resource "buddy_target" "ssh_password_in_environment" {
  domain         = "myworkspace"
  environment_id = "myenv"
  name           = "SSH Server"
  identifier     = "ssh-server"
  type           = "SSH"
  host           = "ssh.example.com"
  port           = "22"
  path           = "/var/www"
  auth {
    method   = "PASSWORD"
    username = "sshuser"
    password = "secret"
  }
}

resource "buddy_target" "ssh_key" {
  domain     = "myworkspace"
  name       = "SSH Server"
  identifier = "ssh-server"
  type       = "SSH"
  host       = "ssh.example.com"
  port       = "22"
  path       = "/var/www"
  auth {
    method     = "SSH_KEY"
    username   = "sshuser"
    key        = "-----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----\n..."
    passphrase = "keypassphrase"
  }
}

resource "buddy_target" "ssh_asset" {
  domain     = "myworkspace"
  name       = "SSH Server with Asset"
  identifier = "ssh-server-asset"
  type       = "SSH"
  host       = "ssh.example.com"
  port       = "22"
  path       = "/var/www"
  auth {
    method   = "ASSETS_KEY"
    username = "sshuser"
    asset    = "id_workspace"
  }
}

resource "buddy_target" "ssh_proxy_in_pipeline" {
  domain      = "myworkspace"
  pipeline_id = 12345
  name        = "SSH via Proxy"
  identifier  = "ssh-proxy"
  type        = "SSH"
  host        = "internal.example.com"
  port        = "22"
  path        = "/var/www"
  auth {
    method = "PROXY_CREDENTIALS"
  }
  proxy {
    name = "Jump Host"
    host = "proxy.example.com"
    port = "22"
    auth {
      method   = "PASSWORD"
      username = "proxyuser"
      password = "proxypass"
    }
  }
}

resource "buddy_target" "ssh_proxy_key" {
  domain       = "myworkspace"
  project_name = "myproject"
  name         = "SSH via Proxy"
  identifier   = "ssh-proxy"
  type         = "SSH"
  host         = "internal.example.com"
  port         = "22"
  path         = "/var/www"
  auth {
    method   = "PROXY_KEY"
    username = "myuser"
  }
  proxy {
    name = "Jump Host"
    host = "proxy.example.com"
    port = "22"
    auth {
      method     = "SSH_KEY"
      username   = "proxyuser"
      key        = "-----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----\n..."
      passphrase = "keypassphrase"
    }
  }
}

resource "buddy_target" "git_http" {
  domain     = "myworkspace"
  name       = "Git Repository"
  identifier = "git-repo"
  type       = "GIT"
  repository = "https://github.com/example/repo.git"
  tags       = ["production", "backend"]
  auth {
    method   = "HTTP"
    username = "gituser"
    password = "token"
  }
}

resource "buddy_target" "git_ssh" {
  domain     = "myworkspace"
  name       = "Git SSH Repository"
  identifier = "git-ssh-repo"
  type       = "GIT"
  repository = "git@github.com:example/repo.git"
  auth {
    method = "SSH_KEY"
    key    = "-----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----\n..."
  }
}

resource "buddy_target" "digitalocean" {
  domain      = "myworkspace"
  name        = "DigitalOcean Server"
  identifier  = "do-server"
  type        = "DIGITAL_OCEAN"
  host        = "droplet.example.com"
  port        = "22"
  integration = buddy_integration.do.identifier
  auth {
    method   = "PASSWORD"
    username = "root"
    password = "secret"
  }
}

resource "buddy_target" "restricted" {
  domain     = "myworkspace"
  name       = "Restricted Server"
  identifier = "restricted-server"
  type       = "SSH"
  host       = "secure.example.com"
  port       = "22"
  auth {
    method   = "SSH_KEY"
    username = "deploy"
    key      = "-----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----\n..."
  }
  permissions {
    others = "USE_ONLY"
    users {
      id           = buddy_member.developer.member_id
      access_level = "USE_ONLY"
    }
    groups {
      id           = buddy_group.devops.group_id
      access_level = "MANAGE"
    }
  }
}

resource "buddy_target" "mysql" {
  domain     = "myworkspace"
  name       = "MySQL"
  identifier = "mysql"
  type       = "MYSQL"
  host       = "mysql.example.com"
  port       = "3306"
  database   = "myapp"
  ssl_mode   = "REQUIRE"
  auth {
    method   = "PASSWORD"
    username = "deploy"
    password = "secret"
  }
}

resource "buddy_target" "mongo_via_ssh" {
  domain      = "myworkspace"
  name        = "MongoDB"
  identifier  = "mongo"
  type        = "MONGO"
  host        = "10.0.0.5"
  port        = "27017"
  database    = "myapp"
  auth_source = "admin"
  auth {
    method   = "PASSWORD"
    username = "deploy"
    password = "secret"
  }
  proxy {
    name = buddy_target.restricted.identifier
  }
}

resource "buddy_target" "clickhouse" {
  domain     = "myworkspace"
  name       = "ClickHouse"
  identifier = "clickhouse"
  type       = "CLICKHOUSE"
  host       = "clickhouse.example.com"
  port       = "9000"
  database   = "default"
  secure     = false
  auth {
    method   = "PASSWORD"
    username = "default"
    password = "secret"
  }
}

# the repository target every project gets - import it first:
# terraform import buddy_target.project_repo myworkspace:<target_id of identifier project_repository>
resource "buddy_target" "project_repo" {
  domain                 = "myworkspace"
  project_name           = "myproject"
  type                   = "PROJECT_REPO"
  identifier             = "project_repository"
  sandboxes_access_level = "DENIED"
  allowed_environments {
    project      = "myproject"
    environment  = "staging"
    access_level = "READ_WRITE"
  }
  allowed_environments {
    environment  = "shared"
    access_level = "READ_ONLY"
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The workspace's URL handle
- `identifier` (String) The target's identifier
- `type` (String) The target's type. Allowed: `FTP`, `SSH`, `MATCH`, `UPCLOUD`, `VULTR`, `DIGITAL_OCEAN`, `GIT`, `MYSQL`, `MONGO`, `CLICKHOUSE`, `PROJECT_REPO`. `PROJECT_REPO` is the project's repository, every project gets one with identifier `project_repository` - import it to manage its access rules, destroying the resource deletes it. The API does not update `name`, `note`, `agent_note`, `tags`, `disabled` and `permissions` of a `PROJECT_REPO` target, changing them is rejected at plan time

### Optional

- `agent_note` (String) The target's agent note
- `allowed_environments` (Block Set) List of environments whose sandboxes are allowed to use this target. A rule for a specific sandbox in `allowed_sandboxes` takes precedence over an environment rule. Only for `PROJECT_REPO` (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--allowed_environments))
- `allowed_pipeline` (Block Set) List of specific pipelines allowed to use this target (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--allowed_pipeline))
- `allowed_sandboxes` (Block Set) List of specific sandboxes allowed to use this target. Only for `PROJECT_REPO` (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--allowed_sandboxes))
- `auth` (Block Set) The target's auth. Set for `FTP`, `GIT`, `SSH`, `UPCLOUD`, `VULTR`, `DIGITAL_OCEAN`, `MYSQL`, `MONGO`, `CLICKHOUSE` (`PASSWORD` only) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--auth))
- `auth_source` (String) The authentication database (e.g. `admin`), the target's `database` when not set. Set for `MONGO`
- `ca_certificate` (String, Sensitive) The PEM-encoded CA certificate. Set for `MYSQL` with `ssl_mode` = `VERIFY_FULL`
- `database` (String) The default database. Set for `MYSQL`, `MONGO`, `CLICKHOUSE`
- `disabled` (Boolean) Defines whether or not the target can be run
- `environment_id` (String) The environment's id. A target has a single owner, provide only one of: `project_name`, `pipeline_id`, `environment_id`
- `host` (String) The target's host. Set for `FTP`, `SSH`, `UPCLOUD`, `VULTR`, `DIGITAL_OCEAN`, `MYSQL`, `MONGO`, `CLICKHOUSE`
- `integration` (String) The target's integration. Set for `UPCLOUD`, `VULTR`, `DIGITAL_OCEAN`
- `name` (String) The target's name. Required for every type except `PROJECT_REPO`, leave it out to keep the name of an imported `PROJECT_REPO` target
- `note` (String) The target's note
- `path` (String) The target's path
- `permissions` (Block Set) The target's permissions (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--permissions))
- `pipeline_id` (Number) The pipeline's id. A target has a single owner, provide only one of: `project_name`, `pipeline_id`, `environment_id`
- `pipelines_access_level` (String) Indicates if all pipelines are allowed to use this target
- `port` (String) The target's port. Set for `FTP`, `SSH`, `UPCLOUD`, `VULTR`, `DIGITAL_OCEAN`, `MYSQL`, `MONGO`, `CLICKHOUSE`
- `project_name` (String) The project's name. A target has a single owner, provide only one of: `project_name`, `pipeline_id`, `environment_id`
- `proxy` (Block Set) The target's proxy. Set for `SSH`. For `MYSQL`, `MONGO`, `CLICKHOUSE` only `name` - the identifier of an SSH target to tunnel through (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--proxy))
- `repository` (String) The target's repository. Set for `GIT`
- `sandboxes_access_level` (String) The default access level for sandboxes, `allowed_sandboxes` and `allowed_environments` are exceptions from it. Only for `PROJECT_REPO`, the API sets `READ_ONLY` when it is not set
- `scope` (String) The target's scope. Set for `MATCH`
- `secure` (Boolean) The target's secure setting. Set for `FTP` and `CLICKHOUSE` (TLS on the native protocol)
- `ssl_mode` (String) The SSL connection mode. Set for `MYSQL`. Allowed: `DISABLE`, `REQUIRE` (default, encrypted, certificate not validated), `VERIFY_FULL` (requires `ca_certificate`)
- `tags` (Set of String) The target's list of tags

### Read-Only

- `html_url` (String) The target's URL
- `id` (String) The Terraform resource identifier for this item
- `target_id` (String) The targets's ID

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# import using domain(mydomain) and target_id (a1b2c3d4)
terraform import buddy_target.test mydomain:a1b2c3d4
```
